notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping a Devil, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Devil, adding {C}{C}.
When the Devil dies, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping a Devil, untapping Marina.
Repeat.
